basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from New York City, just diving into the world of Reddit and gaming. I spend most of my free time exploring new games and binge-watching series. I have a keen interest in storytelling games like 'Detroit: Become Human' and enjoy discussing them online. I am currently single and enjoy hanging out with friends on weekends. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am relatively new to the gaming scene, primarily learning through YouTube tutorials and recommendations from friends. My knowledge is mostly self-taught, focusing on popular story-driven games and the occasional multiplayer experience.
